title: JET Moesha Cover Signed by Marcus T. Paulk – Framed – Brandy, Sheryl Lee Ralph
descriptionText:
This is a framed JET Magazine cover from February 1996, featuring the cast of Moesha—a beloved 90s sitcom known for its positive portrayal of Black family life. This particular issue is hand-signed by Marcus T. Paulk, who played Myles Mitchell, Moesha’s younger brother.

Signed by Marcus T. Paulk near his image on the cover in bold black ink.

Details:

Authentic 1996 JET Magazine cover (not a reprint)
Signed by Marcus T. Paulk (Myles from Moesha)
Features Brandy, Sheryl Lee Ralph, and William Allen Young on the cover
Professionally framed with a matte border – ready to display
No COA, but obtained from a collection tied to a former Radio Aahs employee
A great nostalgic piece for 90s TV fans and collectors of Black entertainment history
Condition:
Cover and frame are in very good condition. Slight signs of age on the magazine, consistent with its vintage nature. Signature is clean and legible.

This signed item was acquired at an estate auction featuring memorabilia from a former employee of Radio Aahs, a well-known national children's radio network active in the 1990s. The collection included numerous entertainment industry items, suggesting access to press and promotional materials. While no certificate of authenticity is included, this context supports its legitimacy.
